title: Noteman Database Design
description: Relational SQLite database schema for Noteman local-first note management.

subjects.name: subjects
subjects.description: Academic subjects or courses enrolled by the user.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique subject identifier / course code.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Human-readable subject name.

columns.name: semester
columns.description: Academic semester code.

threads.name: threads
threads.description: Study threads or lesson topics under a specific subject.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique thread identifier (UUID v4 or custom string).

columns.name: subject_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing subjects(id).

columns.name: title
columns.description: Thread or lesson topic title.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Short summary or description about the lesson covered in this thread.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing when the thread was created.

files.name: files
files.description: Metadata for files managed by Noteman (user notes and imported materials).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique file identifier (UUID v4).

columns.name: thread_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing threads(id).

columns.name: file_name
columns.description: Original file name with extension.

columns.name: file_type
columns.description: File extension or type category.

columns.name: storage_path
columns.description: Relative directory path where the file is physically stored inside the application directory (users/{user_id}/courses/{subject_id}/{thread_id}/[notes|materials|media]/{category}/{file_id}_{file_name}).

columns.name: is_material
columns.description: Boolean flag: 1 if the file is imported course material, 0 if it is a user note/document.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing users(id) for user isolation. Nullable for unassigned files.

tasks.name: tasks
tasks.description: Actionable tasks and homework deadlines linked to study threads.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique task identifier (UUID v4).

columns.name: thread_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing threads(id).

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title or summary of the task.

columns.name: deadline
columns.description: Target completion timestamp (ISO 8601 string or date format).

users.name: users
users.description: User accounts and workspace identities with optional password authentication (salt and pepper).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique user identifier (UUID v4).

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Generated virtual alias column matching id.

columns.name: userid
columns.description: Generated virtual alias column matching id.

columns.name: username
columns.description: Unique login username or handle.

columns.name: email
columns.description: User email address.

columns.name: hashed_password
columns.description: SHA-256 password hash computed with salt and application pepper. Null if password left blank.

columns.name: salt
columns.description: Per-user cryptographically random salt string. Null if password left blank.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing when the user account was created.

_migrations.name: _migrations
_migrations.description: Internal audit log of sequentially applied schema migrations.

columns.name: version
columns.description: Sequential migration version number matching PRAGMA user_version.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Human-readable migration identifier.

columns.name: applied_at
columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing when the migration was committed.

principles: Migrations are strictly forward-only and version-numbered sequentially (1, 2, 3...).
Each migration runs in an isolated SQLite transaction that executes DDL, logs into _migrations, and updates PRAGMA user_version atomically.
Schema changes MUST be appended to MIGRATIONS in migrations.rs without altering historic migrations.
